title: Ask The Person Input
description: One question for a person, complete enough to answer without opening anything. The same fields as DecisionRequestSchema in schemas/process/decision-request.ts, plus a letter per option so the chat text and the card use the same handles. Every field is required: a question with no comparison, no recommendation or no default does not validate.

decides.description: What is being decided, stated as what will DIFFER depending on the answer. Not the name of the decision.

context.description: Why it is being asked now and what happens next: the PRs, beans and pages it touches, each named in words. Links are for more, never where terms are defined.

glossary.description: Every id, path and coined name used above, glossed. {} means nothing needs a gloss.

letter.description: The handle shown in BOTH the chat text and the card.

label.description: Short noun phrase the person taps.

downstream.description: What it changes for everything else, afterwards.

recommends.description: The letter of the recommended option; it is shown first and marked.

ifSilent.description: What will be done if no answer comes. Then it is done.

othersPending.description: How many other decisions wait; given as a count, never as a list of option names.

reversible.description: false when acting on the answer cannot be undone. Then the default is never taken on silence: the step waits.
